reportTakeaways: Friday benchmarks closed lower after recovering from intraday lows.
Broader-market and sector weakness warrants attention beyond headline indices.
reportWatch: Crude oil, rupee and quarterly earnings
Institutional cash flows and exchange-verified expiry positioning
body: What moved | Indian equities ended Friday lower after recovering from deeper intraday losses. Broader-market weakness and pressure across several sectors showed that the decline extended beyond the headline indices.

Sectors and stocks | Consumer durables, energy, FMCG and automobiles were among the weaker groups. Reuters highlighted weakness in HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and Bajaj Finance; Swiggy also faced pressure. These are selected examples, not a ranked leaderboard.

Why it mattered | Higher crude oil prices amid Middle East tensions raised concerns about inflation, margins and the rupee. Investors should distinguish Friday's closing move from the full week's return.
Looking ahead | Watch crude oil, the rupee, quarterly earnings, institutional flows and expiry positioning. These are monitoring priorities, not price forecasts.
article.indiaImpact: Broader-market and sector weakness shows why investors should monitor breadth and risk, not just Nifty and Sensex. Weekly and Friday returns are distinct.
